```yaml
name: Promote RC to Stable Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      rc_tag:
        description: 'RC Tag (e.g., v3.0.0-rc5)'
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Validate RC tag
        run: |
          git fetch --tags
          if ! git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/tags/${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"; then
            echo "::error::RC tag ${github.event.inputs.rc_tag} does not exist"
            exit 1
          fi
          if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/tags/v${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }} | sed 's/-rc[0-9]*$//'"; then
            echo "::error::Stable tag already exists for this RC"
            exit 1
          fi

  promote:
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Create stable tag
        run: |
          git tag "v$(echo ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }} | sed 's/-rc[0-9]*$//')"
          git push origin "v$(echo ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }} | sed 's/-rc[0-9]*$//')"

      - name: Retag Docker images
        run: |
          docker buildx imagetools create grafana/beyla:${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }} -t grafana/beyla:v$(echo ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }} | sed 's/-rc[0-9]*$//')
          docker buildx imagetools create grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }} -t grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:v$(echo ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }} | sed 's/-rc[0-9]*$//')

      - name: Copy binary assets
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist/stable
          cp dist/rc/* dist/stable/

      - name: Create GitHub release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: "${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag | replace('-rc[0-9]*$', '') }}"
          file: dist/stable/*
          asset_name: "beyla-${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag | replace('-rc[0-9]*$', '') }}.tar.gz"
          overwrite: true
          promote: false
          file_glob: false
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          make_latest: false
          release_name: "Beyla v${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag | replace('-rc[0-9]*$', '') }}"
          body: "Promoted RC to stable release."
          target_commit: ${{ github.sha }}
          repo_name: grafana/beyla
          release_id: null

  summary:
    needs: promote
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Print promotion summary
        run: |
          echo "Promotion completed successfully!"
          echo "- [ ] Publish Helm charts"
          echo "- [ ] Update technical documentation"
```
